title: Ghost hunt to explore Devizes pub said to be cursed by a witch
excerpt: Devizes mediums Charlie and Natalie lead a ghost walk and paranormal investigation on October 31.
content:
Ghost walk and paranormal investigation planned in Devizes

 

Devizes mediums Charlie and Natalie lead a ghost walk and paranormal investigation (Image: Supplied)

This article is brought to you by our exclusive subscriber partnership with our sister title USA Today, and has been written by our American colleagues. It does not necessarily reflect the view of The Herald.

A spooky night of ghost hunting is set to take place on Hallowe'en.

The Spirit Whisperers, psychic mediums Charlie and Natalie from Devizes, will lead a ghost walk and paranormal investigation on October 31, starting at 8pm in Devizes.

The event will conclude at The White Bear, believed to be the oldest pub in Devizes and said to be cursed by a witch.

The mediums, who have been working together for around six years and have been featured in Take A Break Magazine, specialise in readings, house cleansings, and getting rid of bad ghosts and energy.

The White Bear is said to be the site of a historic curse, placed by a witch after her horse fell into the cellar.

Organisers claim that "there's a lot of activity in there."

Tickets are £20 and are available through The White Bear or by messaging the psychic mediums' page.
